To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a taxonomy and ontology for computer network attacks have been developed.
(1) a taxonomy is a classification scheme that is based on the attributes of a concept and (2) an ontology is a taxonomy with a formal definition.

a taxonomy of network attacks is a useful tool for understanding and classifying network attacks and the taxonomy presented in this paper is the first to present the attacker's and defender's point of views of network attacks.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: How can we classify a network attack in an automated manner? Which characteristics are necessary to describe an attack? What is an adequate representation for these characteristics?
developing a taxonomy and ontology that will allow the automated classification of a network based attack.
developing an ontology that can be used to automate the classification process of computer network attacks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a computer network attack taxonomy and ontology has been proposed and presented in this paper.
the ontology presented in this paper can be used to automate the classification and mitigation of network attacks.
a taxonomy is a classification of a specific domain of objects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the authors have proposed an attack ontology that could be used for the automation of the classification of network attack.
a computer network attack ontology is presented which can be used as a tool to automatically classify computer network attacks and to identify the type of the attack.
a computer network attack can be classified by using the proposed ontology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ontology provides a framework for the development and implementation of automated attack detection systems.
the proposed ontology can be used to automate classification of a network based attack during its early stage.
a computer network attack can be characterized and classified by using the proposed ontology, and the attack can be mitigated accordingly.
